name: Colonycraft
description: Found colonies with a Town Hall, buy prefab farms, ranches, apiaries, fisheries, mines, lumber camps, workshops, storehouses, harbors, train stations, trading posts with master traders, a bank, a museum, a chapel, a library and medieval walls with Marks, and let your villagers gather for you. Wages every morning, optional auto-sell to the Market. Works with Warehouse, Cargo Train, Havana, Burlap Sack, Riches and Fossil Fool. Server-side: vanilla clients can join.
